subject.title: fix(gateway): isolate wizard exits from shared process

question: Should the Gateway publicly support `wizard.start.installDaemon` so embedding clients can explicitly retain ownership of daemon installation?
rationale: The implementation preserves the existing CLI default when omitted, but exposing this field adds a durable remote protocol capability rather than only repairing internal exit containment.

options.title: Accept the additive RPC contract
options.body: Land the optional field with its current omission-preserving behavior so embedding clients can explicitly own service installation.

options.title: Land lifecycle containment only
options.body: Remove the protocol addition and retain only the non-exiting runtime fix if service-install ownership should remain outside the Gateway RPC surface.

options.title: Pause for protocol direction
options.body: Hold the PR until Gateway API ownership and downstream-client expectations are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive RPC contract
recommendation.body: Land the optional field with its current omission-preserving behavior so embedding clients can explicitly own service installation.

likelyOwner.reason: CassieMei authored the current implementation, though ownership evidence from current-main history is limited in the available review context.
